backend/main.mo: Actor with a placeholder submitContactForm function that currently traps on invocation.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing business-name update tasks, affected frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend component and configuration file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Defines global Tailwind styles and OKLCH-based design tokens for both light and dark themes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry file containing metadata, SEO tags, JSON-LD business schema, and font preloads.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app composing all marketing sections, navigation, footer, and mobile CTA bar.
frontend/src/components/marketing/contac: Form component that validates user input and submits contact inquiries using a mutation hook, showing success or error alerts.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Footer: Footer with business info, quick navigation links, contact details, and caffeine.ai attribution.
frontend/src/components/marketing/sectio: Displays an About section with four feature cards highlighting the agency’s strengths and services.
Renders a contact section with address, phone, email, working hours, and embeds the contact inquiry form.
Shows a grid gallery of travel destination images with hover overlays and titles.
Hero banner with background image, tagline, call-to-action buttons, and service statistics.
Lists popular travel routes with distance, duration, descriptions, and quick call or WhatsApp booking buttons.
Displays customer reviews with star ratings and an average rating summary.
Renders a services section listing various taxi and travel offerings with icons and descriptions.
Displays a grid of tour packages with images, descriptions, highlights, and a contact scroll action.
Shows available vehicle types with features and a list of quality assurances for the fleet.
Presents key benefits of the service using icons, titles, and descriptions in a grid layout.
frontend/src/components/marketing/Sticky: Mobile-only bottom CTA bar providing quick Call and WhatsApp actions.
frontend/src/components/marketing/TopNav: Sticky navigation bar with smooth-scroll section links, mobile menu, and a call button.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Manages creation and caching of backend actors based on Internet Identity, auto‑refetching dependent queries on change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides internet identity context, handling login, logout, stored identities, and auth client setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Placeholder hook returning no queries for this static marketing site.
Mutation hook that submits contact form data through the backend actor and invalidates related queries.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles and theme variables for light and dark modes with a warm travel‑themed palette.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider and loads global styles.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration enabling dark mode, custom color palette, fonts, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state describing requirements and features for building an SEO-optimized one-page travel agency website with defined sections and CTAs.
